{"id":1583362713,"question_id":273,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1742739070,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1583362713/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Integer to English Words","memory":"12.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<pair<string, int>> mp = {\n    {\"Billion\", 1000000000}, {\"Million\", 1000000}, {\"Thousand\", 1000}, {\"Hundred\", 100},\n    {\"Ninety\", 90}, {\"Eighty\", 80}, {\"Seventy\", 70}, {\"Sixty\", 60}, {\"Fifty\", 50}, {\"Forty\", 40}, {\"Thirty\", 30},\n    {\"Twenty\", 20}, {\"Nineteen\", 19}, {\"Eighteen\", 18}, {\"Seventeen\", 17}, {\"Sixteen\", 16}, {\"Fifteen\", 15}, \n    {\"Fourteen\", 14}, {\"Thirteen\", 13}, {\"Twelve\", 12}, {\"Eleven\", 11}, {\"Ten\", 10}, {\"Nine\", 9}, {\"Eight\", 8}, \n    {\"Seven\", 7}, {\"Six\", 6}, {\"Five\", 5}, {\"Four\", 4}, {\"Three\", 3}, {\"Two\", 2}, {\"One\", 1}};\n\n    string numberToWords(int num) {\n        if(num == 0)\n        {\n            return \"Zero\";\n        }\n        \n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(num >= it.second)\n            {\n                string a = \"\";\n                if(num >= 100)\n                {\n                    a = numberToWords(num / it.second)+ \" \";\n                }\n                string b = it.first;\n\n                string c = \"\";\n                if(num % it.second != 0)\n                {\n                    c = \" \" + numberToWords(num % it.second);\n                }\n            return a+ b +c;\n            }\n        }\n    return \"\";\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"integer-to-english-words","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":491}
